headline: Capri Holdings Q3 Earnings Top Estimates on Strong Revenue
summary: Capri Holdings reported an earnings per share beat of $0.21, with quarterly revenue topping analyst estimates.
why: Luxury apparel and accessories earnings provide insight into consumer discretionary spending trends and brand demand across global markets.

impacts.name: Capri Holdings
impacts.why: Beating consensus earnings and revenue estimates generally drives positive equity momentum.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Better-than-expected quarterly earnings and revenue performance exceeded consensus forecasts, lifting the company's stock valuation.
